info.title: ClinicalCare API
info.description: Clinical encounters (and, later, vitals). Every endpoint requires the shared X-Internal-Gateway-Secret header (ADR 0055, ADR 0064) -- there is no per-user authentication yet, so the acting provider is supplied by the caller.

post.summary: Create an encounter for a registered patient

get.summary: List one patient's encounters, newest first, one bounded page at a time

put.summary: Replace an encounter's editable fields, conditional on the ETag the caller read

get.summary: Get one encounter by its uuid

post.summary: Record a set of vital signs for an encounter

get.summary: List an encounter's vitals, newest first, one bounded page at a time

put.summary: Replace a set of vital signs, conditional on the ETag the caller read

get.summary: Get one set of vitals

post.summary: Record a problem on a registered patient's list

get.summary: List one patient's problems, newest first, one bounded page at a time

put.summary: Replace a problem's editable fields, conditional on the ETag the caller read (resolve it by sending an end date)

get.summary: Get one problem by its uuid, with an ETag

post.summary: Record an immunization on a registered patient's record

get.summary: List one patient's immunizations, most recently administered first, one bounded page at a time

put.summary: Replace an immunization's editable fields, conditional on the ETag the caller read (set enteredInError to void a mistaken entry)

get.summary: Get one immunization by its uuid, with an ETag

post.summary: Record a SOAP note on an encounter

get.summary: List an encounter's SOAP notes, newest first, one bounded page at a time

put.summary: Replace a SOAP note's sections, conditional on the ETag the caller read

get.summary: Get one SOAP note of an encounter, with an ETag

post.summary: Record a clinical note on an encounter

get.summary: List an encounter's clinical notes, newest first, one bounded page at a time

put.summary: Replace a clinical note's editable fields, conditional on the ETag the caller read

get.summary: Get one clinical note of an encounter, with an ETag
List the encounter classes (legacy _ActEncounterCode), in legacy's order
List the active facilities, by name
List the active visit categories, as legacy's visit form offers them
List the active choices for an immunization's coded fields (vaccine, route, site, status, source, refusal reason, unit)
List the active clinical note types, in legacy's order
List the active clinical note categories, in legacy's order

post.summary: Record an allergy on a registered patient's list

get.summary: List one patient's allergies, newest first, one bounded page at a time

put.summary: Replace an allergy's editable fields, conditional on the ETag the caller read (end it by sending an end date)

get.summary: Get one allergy by its uuid, with an ETag

put.summary: Link a problem or an allergy to an encounter that addressed it (idempotent)

delete.summary: Remove the link between an encounter and an issue (the issue and the encounter are untouched; idempotent)

get.summary: List the problems and allergies linked to an encounter, one bounded page at a time

InternalGateway.description: The shared secret configured by InternalGatewayOptions.Secret. Gates the service shut to anyone else; it does not identify which end user is behind the call.
InternalGateway.name: X-Internal-Gateway-Secret
